name: gas-station
summary: A flat white fuel canopy with a red brand stripe stands on four slim columns over two pump islands. Behind it is a low flat-roofed store: a glass-fronted white shop under a red sign fascia and cantilever awning, beside a taller grey service block. A red-and-black price pylon stands at the street corner. The canopy, the pumps under it, the pylon and the glass shop behind the forecourt make it read as a gas station at a glance. Flat white canopy with a red stripe on four columns over two pump islands. Behind it, a white glass-front store with a red MART fascia beside a taller grey service block. A red-headed price pylon, an asphalt lot and the forecourt fittings complete the site. (15 of 15 parts finished)
